title: Google tweaks its AI shopping experience ahead of the holidays
key_facts: Google added an AI performance insights tab in Merchant Center
Retailers can see real shopper wording on AI surfaces like AI Mode
Google began beta testing business agents (chat ads) for YouTube ads
Tapestry uses UCP-powered checkout for Coach and Kate Spade in AI Mode and Gemini
Merchants can transfer carts to own sites, test checkout flows, view analytics
eMarketer's Sky Canaves says adoption of Google's tools remains "fairly limited"
Event was more a progress update than a flood of new announcements
quote_evidence: Overall, Google’s Rethink event was more of a progress update on the adoption of Google’s existing agentic shopping features, many of which were first announced at NRF in January, rather than a flood of new announcements.
While Google continues to invest in AI shopping, Canaves said, adoption of Google’s tools remains “fairly limited.”
why_it_matters_hint: Existing features getting wider use; adoption by shoppers is the open question.
notes: Announcements were made at Google's Rethink event in September (day not stated) and many features were first announced in January; score lowered by 1 (5 to 4). Freshness date not parseable because no day is given.
